events.text: Team Leader, do you have anything on the map?
This is the strongest read I have: east wall — there's a panel behind the bookshelf.
That fits cleaner than I expected.
Puzzle Solver, anything on the pattern?
Nice — that clears one blocker.
There's a pattern forming — that fits.
This is the interpretation that keeps clicking for me: triangle, circle, square.
Nice one — that helps a lot.
Code Breaker, we can't move without the key. Talk to me.
Good, that helps.
Code Breaker, we're waiting on the key.
Lock done. Here's the key clue: under the loose tile by the door.
Good — don't slow down.
What if the key doesn't mean what we thought? Quick sanity check.
Scout, do you have anything on the code?
Scout, we still need the code.
Right, here's what I've got: four, two, seven, one.
That fits cleaner than I expected.
Alright — 4-2-7-1. Everyone hold.
Yes — door's open. That was the last piece.
